name: janitor-report
tagline_zh: 你的技能库乱成一团？一条命令扫出全部错误、重复和坏技能。连隐藏的僵尸技能都揪出来，还附修复建议。
tagline_en: One command to scan all your skills for errors, duplicates, and breakage. Even finds zombie skills, with fix tips.
desc_en: Full health check of all your skills in one report. Use when the user wants to check for errors, find duplicates, detect broken skills, or get a complete overview of skill health. Pass --brief for inventory only. Trigger with '/janitor-report'.
why_zh: 同类只查表面，它深挖依赖和冲突，并给出具体修复步骤，而非笼统警告。
why_en: Unlike shallow scanners, it digs into dependencies and conflicts, offering concrete fixes, not vague alerts.
